subject: Duplicate invoice postings in batch run — customer credit memos & VAT reversal plan
messages:
From: Jordan Keane <j.keane@acmecloud.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 4 Apr 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Unexpected credit memos applied to Apr invoices

Hi Laura —

We received credit memos on our account that appear to offset invoices 9742 and 9748 for March usage. Our AP team did not request credits; can you confirm why those were issued and whether VAT was reversed on those lines? We need to reconcile before the month close.

Thanks,
Jordan Keane

finance@acmecloud.com

Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Apr 2028 08:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Unexpected credit memos applied to Apr invoices

Jordan —

Thanks for flagging this. I’m sorry for the surprise — we’re investigating immediately. Initial look shows credit memos tied to invoices 9742/9748 that should not have been generated; I’ve looped in Finance Ops and Payments so we can confirm the cause and next steps.

Immediate plan:
- I will confirm whether VAT reversal was included and share the AR snapshot for your AP team.
- If these credits were applied in error we’ll issue reversing journal entries and re-issue corrected invoices/credits before your month close.
- I’ll follow up with a clear timeline by EOD PT.

Can you confirm your AP cut-off timezone so we prioritize accordingly?

Apologies again — we’ll get this sorted.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Apr 2028 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: AR alert: duplicate postings from billing batch affecting EU accounts (Acme Cloud)

Team —

FYI: Acme Cloud (ACME-3472) just raised an issue — two credit memos were created and applied against invoices 9742 & 9748. Net on the AR ledger we now show negative outstanding for some EU accounts and VAT reversal entries posted to the wrong tax code (we flagged EU_VAT_OUT instead of EU_VAT_REV).

I pulled the AR aging snapshot (attached) and the top-line impact is ~€42,300 across 6 invoices. We need a corrective plan because:
- Customer month-close is tomorrow EOD CET.
- VAT treatment is material for their reclaim.
- We should avoid issuing live re-bills without a clear audit trail.

Ask: Can Finance Ops create a reversing journal and proper credit memos tied to the original invoice numbers, with the correct VAT reversal tax code? Marcus — can you confirm root cause and whether the billing batch retry created duplicate invoice application IDs? Aditya — if we need to do a manual ledger correction, please outline journal entries and approvals required.

I’ll reply to Jordan with an ETA and attach the AR snapshot.

Attachments: ar-aging-snapshot-20280404.csv

Thanks,
Laura
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Apr 2028 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AR alert: duplicate postings from billing batch affecting EU accounts (Acme Cloud)

Laura —

Root cause (summary): billing-batch-20280403 retried on stale S3 payloads after a partial timeout. Due to a missing idempotency key for the invoice-apply step, the batch re-applied credits for a small EU cohort where post-processing had already completed. The system generated credit memos and also wrote VAT reversal lines to tax code EU_VAT_OUT instead of EU_VAT_REV due to a map lookup error for internal office "eu-west-1".

Remediation plan (proposed):
1) Block further retries in the batch scheduler for the 2028-04-03 run (done).
2) Create reversing journal entries to neutralize the accidental credit memos: DR Sales Returns (4002) CR Accounts Receivable (1100) for the gross amounts; separate VAT reversal lines: DR VAT Payable (2201) CR VAT Reversal (3209) mapped to EU_VAT_REV. Use journal-entry-template.xlsx (attached).
3) Re-issue correct credit memos referencing original invoice numbers, attach audit note that they replace the erroneous memos.
4) Confirm with Tax that EU_VAT_REV is the correct reclaim code (Grace to confirm).
5) Patch billing code to enforce idempotency on invoice-apply and add monitoring alert (JIRA-INVPROC-1194).

Timeline: We can have draft reversing journals + credit memos ready for review by 2028-04-05 11:00 PT (which is 2028-04-05 19:00 CET). If Acme needs an earlier commitment to avoid cut-off disputes, we can issue provisional memos with a clear audit tag.

I attached the journal template and will populate lines once Aditya confirms the ledgers.

-Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Finance Ops
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Keane <j.keane@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Apr 2028 14:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected credit memos applied to Apr invoices — remediation & ETA

Jordan —

Update and apologies again. Root cause was an internal retry duplication in a billing batch; we also discovered the VAT reversal lines were posted to the wrong tax code. We will:

- Create reversing journal entries and issue corrected credit memos that reference the original invoices (9742, 9748).
- Correct the VAT mapping so the reversal posts to EU_VAT_REV and provide you a reconciliation CSV.
- Patch the billing job to prevent duplicate applies going forward.

ETA: Draft reversing journals and corrected credit memos will be with you by 2028-04-05 19:00 CET (attached when ready). If you need a signed provisional memo before your close, tell me and we’ll expedite.

Attachments: cust-credit-memo-ACME-INV-9742.pdf (provisional)

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
